description: Workshop BCN - Mappatura POI Completa - Aree Wi Fi is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. Il dataset espone la mappatura dei Punti di interesse (POI) individuati nella città di Bologna.In questo dataset vengono estrapolati e presentati i punti di interesse subito adiacenti alle zone coperte dagli hotspot del Wi-Fi comunale, suddivisi nelle seguente tipologie:BibliotecaMusei, Gallerie, Luoghi e Teatri storiciEventoScuolaStruttura sanitariaArea verdeCasa di quartiereArea OrtivaIn aggiunta a questo dataset, nelle seguenti ... Coverage: Comune di Bologna. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Bologna. Its tags are citta-in-15-minuti, pa-alleata-di-cittadini-e-imprese. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPX, JSON, JSON_LD. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
